meta.name: using-git-worktrees
meta.description: Use when starting feature work that needs isolation from current workspace or before executing implementation plans - ensures an isolated workspace exists via native tools or git worktree fallback

copy.tagline: 创建独立工作区以隔离分支开发
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要同时处理同一个仓库的多个分支
copy.tagline_en: Create isolated workspaces for branch development
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work on multiple branches in the same repository

howto.what: Claude在开始新功能或执行实现计划前，会先检查是否已在隔离工作区。如未隔离，则征询同意后，优先使用平台原生工具，否则用git worktree创建隔离工作区，并自动安装依赖、运行测试，确保环境干净。
howto.when: 当需要隔离当前工作空间以开始新功能工作，或执行实现计划之前触发。

say.text: 开始开发新功能，请创建隔离工作区。
say.note: 触发隔离工作区创建流程。

say.text: 我要在独立分支上修改，请设置工作树。
我在子模块中，请按普通仓库处理。
say.note: 技能会检测子模块并跳过创建。

howto.what_en: When starting feature work or before executing implementation plans, Claude checks if already in an isolated workspace. If not, asks consent, then prefers native tools; otherwise uses git worktree to create one, auto-installs dependencies, and runs tests to ensure a clean baseline.
howto.when_en: Triggered when needing isolation from the current workspace to start feature work or before executing implementation plans.

say_en.text: Start developing a new feature, please create an isolated workspace.
I want to work on a separate branch, set up a worktree.
I'm inside a submodule, treat as normal repo.
